content:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a final decision on how failures are surfaced to SDKs/console when requests hit routing fallbacks vs quota limits. Avoid leaving users with vague 'internal error' messages.

Ian: What's the current behavior today?

Maya: Right now: - quota -> 500 with body "quota exceeded" in some places, sometimes a 429 from gateway, SDKs are inconsistent. - routing fallback (e.g., regional capacity) -> 503 but message is "internal server error". - retries from SDKs are all over the place.

Sarah: ouch. That explains a lot of confused support tickets. We should standardize enumerated reasons in the payload so clients can programmatically react.

Devon: agreed. Proposal: canonicalize on these surface types: 
- 429 + Retry-After header + body.reason="quota_exceeded"
- 503 + Retry-After (optional) + body.reason="capacity_unavailable"
- 403 + body.reason="forbidden" (billing/perm reasons)
- 400 + body.reason="invalid_request" (bad input)
- 409 + body.reason="model_mismatch" (incompatible pinned model)
And always include telemetry tags: error_category, error_reason, routing_zone.

Ian: I like that. For 503 we should differentiate transient capacity (auto-retry) vs degraded fallback (permanent for this request). Maybe body.transient=true/false?

Maya: Yes — add a boolean `retryable` flag in the JSON. SDKs should only auto-retry when retryable==true and there's a Retry-After heuristic.

Lisa: Console UX implications: map 429 -> show explicit quota banner and link to quota page. 503 + retryable=true -> amber warning with automatic retry timeline. 503 + retryable=false -> show expanded failure reasons and suggested fallbacks (switch model/region).

Sarah: Telemetry: require these fields on all error events sent to metrics/logs: service, model_tag, region, routing_policy, error_reason, retryable. That will let us split dashboards between quota vs routing incidents.

Devon: SDK change: we add an Error struct with fields (code, reason, retryable, retry_after_seconds, metadata). We need to version bump. @Maya can you confirm wording for `reason` tokens?

Maya: Draft token list: quota_exceeded, capacity_unavailable, forbidden, invalid_request, model_mismatch, rate_limited (for abuse/rapid requests), resource_limits. Keep tokens stable and document in API spec.

Ian: What about HTTP code choices? Some infra folks prefer 502 for model backend failures. Do we care?

Maya: We prefer semantic mapping: 5xx should indicate server-side problems but still use 503 for capacity/routing/backoff scenarios. 502 reserved for protocol/gateway mismatches and should include reason="bad_gateway". Avoid using 500 for anything we want clients to handle specifically.

Lisa: Console ask: expose per-route error breakdown (by reason token) and surface top offending customers for quota. Also an alert if capacity_unavailable > 5% for 5m.

Sarah: Ops question: will rollouts (canary) yield new reason tokens? We should reserve a prefix `rollout_` so old SDKs can ignore unknown tokens gracefully.

Maya: Good point. We'll add `rollout_` prefix for any temporary experiments. SDKs should treat unknown reasons as non-retryable unless `retryable=true`.

Devon: Action items: 1) Maya: finalize token list & add to API spec (due EOD) 2) Devon: add Error struct to SDKs & bump minor (PR by Thu) 3) Lisa: console mapping & dashboard tickets (start tomorrow) 4) Sarah: add telemetry schema + alert rule (this week) 5) Ian: audit gateway to ensure 429/503 header behavior (next sprint).

Ian: tiny nit — prefer header `X-Rw-Error-Reason` for quick routing/NGINX logs so we don't have to parse bodies everywhere. Could be duplicate with body.reason.

Maya: ok +1 for header, but body still required. Add it to spec.

deploy-bot: deploy starting: api-gateway v3.12 -> staging at 1823456805 :rocket:

Devon: noted, will watch for any regressions in staging error surfaces.

Lisa: thanks all — this should cut down the ambiguity in support tickets. :thumbsup:

Maya: I'll post the finalized spec once I update it. If no objections, we'll roll this as a platform cross-team decision and ship changes next week.

Ian: no objections from me.

Sarah: good to go from my side.

Devon: 👍

Maya: (closing) created GH issue #1245 with the token list + action items.
